question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I was in the _________ of a meeting when somebody called me.
solution:
The correct answer is '**middle**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**middle**" means the point or position at an equal distance from the sides, edges, or ends of something. (बीच)
 
• Being in the "**middle**" of a meeting indicates being in the central or most active part of it.
 
• The other options: "**centre**," "**corner**," and "**round**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *I was in the middle__ of a meeting when somebody called me.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Centre (केंद्र)**: A point or part that is equally far from all sides; more commonly used in British English.
 
• **Corner (कोना)**: The place where two lines or surfaces meet, forming an angle.
 
• **Round (गोल)**: Shaped like or approximately like a circle or cylinder.
